about: Reasons for the differences in docs/api/SKLEARN_TWINS.md (tools/api_twin_table.py). First matching rule wins; class, name, ours and sklearn are fnmatch globs (a list means any). A difference that is only a name, a default or a missing alias is fixed in the constructor, not given a reason here.

rules.name: numeric_mode
rules.reason: Mojolearn's numeric contract: 'identical' (the same bits on Apple, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs) or 'fast' (Apple only). scikit-learn has no such choice.

rules.name: device
rules.reason: Mojolearn places the computation on a device ('gpu' or 'cpu'); scikit-learn runs on the host only.

name: check
receipt
rules.reason: Mojolearn's identity tools: `check` refits on the other device and compares the bits, `receipt` records what ran. scikit-learn has no cross-device contract.

name: vendor_used
numeric_mode_used
rules.reason: Reports which GPU vendor and numeric mode the last call ran on; part of the identity contract.

name: save
load
rules.reason: Mojolearn's native model archive (a file format read by the compiled loader on every vendor and the CPU). scikit-learn models are pickled instead; Mojolearn models pickle too.

rules.name: numeric_mode_
rules.reason: The numeric mode the fit ran in; part of the identity contract.

rules.name: input_copied_
rules.reason: Whether fit had to copy X to float32 C order (the kernels read float32 C-contiguous buffers without a copy).

rules.name: feature_names_in_
rules.reason: Mojolearn reads X through the buffer protocol and keeps no column names; storing a DataFrame's names is UNPACK/PACK work in the compiled boundary, not a rename.

rules.name: get_feature_names_out
rules.reason: No feature names are carried (see feature_names_in_); building output names is PACK work in the compiled boundary, not a rename.

rules.name: set_callbacks
rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.9's callback API calls user Python during fit; Mojolearn never calls back into Python during an operation (AGENTS.md, no calls back into Python).

name: densify
sparsify
rules.reason: coef_ is always a dense float32 device result; there is no sparse coefficient storage to convert to or from.

rules.name: partial_fit
rules.reason: Incremental fitting is not implemented in the native fit; it needs kernel and state work, not a rename.

rules.name: warm_start
rules.reason: Warm starts are not implemented in the native fit; it needs kernel and state work, not a rename.

GradientBoostingClassifier/Regressor are adapters over Mojolearn's CatBoost-style symmetric-tree booster (python/mojolearn/_gbdt_adapters.py): its own parameters, defaults (n_estimators=None means the booster's iteration count and learning-rate rule) and fitted state. scikit-learn's per-node growth controls have no counterpart in symmetric trees; the boosting-library parameter names are plan section 3 item 3 (lane api-boost).

rules.name: random_state
rules.reason: Identity: a fixed default seed makes every fit reproducible and the same bits on every vendor; scikit-learn's None draws fresh entropy per fit.

name: shuffle
random_state
rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.9's default is a deprecation sentinel; Mojolearn's default is the explicit value (None uses seed 0, so repeated fits give the same folds).

rules.name: init
rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.9's 'warn' announces a change of default to 'classical_mds'; Mojolearn keeps 'random', the current scikit-learn behavior, and accepts 'classical_mds'.
scikit-learn 1.9's default is a deprecation or warning sentinel; Mojolearn's default is the explicit value the sentinel stands for (or the only value supported).

rules.name: n_init
rules.reason: One start by default (cuML's default); 'auto' (scikit-learn: 1 for k-means++, 10 for random) is not implemented. Changing the default changes fitted centers on every KMeans row: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: algorithm
rules.reason: Exact brute force on the GPU is the only kNN search here ('auto' means 'brute'); scikit-learn's 'auto' picks a CPU tree.

rules.name: metric
rules.reason: 'euclidean' is scikit-learn's default 'minkowski' with p=2, the same distance; Mojolearn names it directly.

rules.name: algorithm
rules.reason: 'rbc' (exact random ball cover, cuML) is Mojolearn's GPU neighborhood search; scikit-learn's 'auto' picks a CPU tree.

rules.name: linkage
rules.reason: Single linkage is the GPU (Boruvka minimum spanning tree) route, as in cuML; 'ward' is accepted but is not the default route. Changing the default changes the clustering: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: tol
rules.reason: cuML's default for the float32 coordinate descent; scikit-learn's 1e-4 is a float64 tolerance. Changing it changes iteration counts and results: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: solver
rules.reason: Only 'qn' (the GPU quasi-Newton solver, cuML's name) exists; scikit-learn's 'lbfgs' is a CPU SciPy solver.

rules.name: max_iter
rules.reason: cuML's default for the float32 quasi-Newton solver. Changing it changes results on unconverged fits: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: l1_ratio
rules.reason: None means no elastic-net share (only used with penalty='elasticnet'); scikit-learn 1.9 moved to l1_ratio=0.0 with the penalty argument deprecated. Same model at the defaults.

rules.name: max_samples
rules.reason: 1.0 (all rows) is what scikit-learn's None means; Mojolearn takes the explicit fraction. Same model.

rules.name: ensemble
rules.reason: scikit-learn's 'auto' means True except for a FrozenEstimator; Mojolearn has no FrozenEstimator, so the default is True. Same model.

rules.name: optimizer
rules.reason: The kernel is fitted as passed by default; the hyperparameter search runs on the host in scikit-learn. GaussianProcessRegressor accepts 'fmin_l_bfgs_b' (a GPU L-BFGS); the classifier has no optimizer. Changing the default changes every fit: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: alpha
rules.reason: The float32 Cholesky needs a larger ridge than scikit-learn's float64 1e-10 to stay positive definite; 2**-20 is exact in float32.

rules.name: max_cluster_size
rules.reason: 0 means no limit (cuML's convention); scikit-learn's None means the same.

rules.name: verbose
rules.reason: False and scikit-learn's 0 both mean silent; only a false value is accepted.

name: degree
coef0
rules.reason: scikit-learn's None means the kernel's own default (3 and 1); Mojolearn writes those values. Same kernel.

rules.name: dtype
rules.reason: The output is always float32 (the GPU kernels' type); dtype is accepted for compatibility.

rules.name: sparse_output
rules.reason: Sparse outputs are not produced; the embedding is a dense float32 array, so only False is accepted.

rules.name: gamma
rules.reason: 'auto' is cuML's default; 'scale' (scikit-learn's) is accepted. Changing the default changes every kernel fit: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: cache_size
rules.reason: Here it sizes the prediction kernel tile (results do not depend on it); scikit-learn's is libsvm's training cache in MiB.

rules.name: affinity
rules.reason: cuML's default ('nearest_neighbors', a sparse kNN graph on the GPU); 'rbf' is accepted. Changing the default changes every fit: an A/B, not a rename.

rules.name: gamma
rules.reason: None means 1.0 (scikit-learn's value) with affinity='rbf' and is refused with other affinities. Same model.

name: degree
coef0
rules.reason: Polynomial and sigmoid affinities are not implemented; only None is accepted.

rules.name: eigen_tol
rules.reason: The GPU eigensolver needs a positive tolerance (1e-5); 'auto' (which maps to 0, no convergence test) is not accepted by SpectralClustering, and SpectralEmbedding's None means 1e-5.

rules.name: algorithm
rules.reason: The exact solver (an eigendecomposition of the Gram matrix on the GPU) is the default; 'randomized' is accepted. Changing the default changes results: an A/B, not a rename.
scikit-learn's positional list includes metric_params, algorithm, leaf_size, n_jobs, store_centers and copy, which are not accepted (see their rows); the accepted ones are in scikit-learn's order.
scikit-learn 1.9 added `loss` as the first parameter; Mojolearn's regressor trains squared error only (see the loss row), so it does not take it.

rules.name: metric_params
rules.reason: Metrics are named and run natively; per-metric parameter dictionaries are not supported.

rules.name: p
rules.reason: Minkowski power is not a parameter of the GPU neighborhood search.

name: algorithm
store_centers
copy
rules.reason: Not implemented: one GPU route (no tree choice), no centroid/medoid storage; X is never modified, but scikit-learn 1.9's copy='warn' deprecation is not mirrored.

rules.name: algorithm
rules.reason: Lloyd iterations are the only GPU algorithm (scikit-learn's default 'lloyd'); 'elkan' is not implemented.

rules.name: radius
rules.reason: radius_neighbors is not implemented (see that row); the radius search is RadiusNeighbors.

rules.name: kernel_params
rules.reason: Kernels are named and run natively; a parameter dictionary for a callable kernel is not supported.

name: positive
tol
max_iter
random_state
rules.reason: Closed-form GPU solves only: no non-negative least squares and no iterative solver, so no tolerance, iteration cap or seed.

name: copy_X
n_jobs
verbose
leaf_size
rules.reason: Its constructor is one call into the compiled classical owner, which stores exactly its declared fields; accepting a no-op keyword needs that native constructor to take it (Mojo work, not a rename). X is never modified, the work runs on the device and the neighbor search builds no tree.

name: dual
intercept_scaling
random_state
rules.reason: The GPU quasi-Newton solver works on the primal only and fits the intercept as its own unpenalized weight (penalized_intercept=True penalizes it), so liblinear's dual, intercept_scaling and seed have no meaning.

rules.name: use_legacy_attributes
rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.9's switch between old and new fitted attribute shapes; Mojolearn has one shape (the legacy one, scikit-learn's current default).

rules.name: dissimilarity
rules.reason: scikit-learn 1.9 deprecated it in favor of metric; Mojolearn takes metric only.

rules.name: loss
rules.reason: Only squared error is trained; scikit-learn 1.9's 'poisson' loss is not implemented.

rules.name: clip
rules.reason: Clipping transformed values to [-1, 1] is not implemented in the native transform (kernel work).

rules.name: shrinking
rules.reason: The GPU SMO solver has no shrinking heuristic; scikit-learn's shrinking changes the iteration path, so accepting and ignoring it would not be honest.

rules.name: validation_fraction
rules.reason: Early stopping on a held-out split is not implemented (early_stopping stops on the training loss).

name: n_iter_without_progress
min_grad_norm
metric
method
angle
rules.reason: One GPU schedule over Euclidean distances with a fixed iteration count: no progress-based stopping, no metric choice, no Barnes-Hut method or angle.

rules.name: verbose_interval
rules.reason: No progress printing (see verbose).

name: inference_engine
n_bins
max_leaves
n_streams
max_batch_size
rules.reason: GPU forest controls in cuML's names: split histogram bins, leaf cap, prediction engine, streams and batch size.

rules.name: batch_size
rules.reason: Minibatch size of the GPU SGD kernel ('auto' picks it); scikit-learn's SGD is per-sample on the CPU.

rules.name: prediction_data
rules.reason: cuML's switch that keeps the data approximate_predict needs.

rules.name: query_tile
rules.reason: Query tile of the brute-force GPU kNN kernel; results do not depend on it.

rules.name: output_type
rules.reason: cuML's output type switch; only None is accepted (results are NumPy or mojolearn.Array).

name: linesearch_max_iter
penalized_intercept
lbfgs_memory
rules.reason: Controls of the GPU quasi-Newton solver, in cuML's names.

rules.name: solver
rules.reason: cuML's solver choice: 'cd' (coordinate descent) or 'qn'.

rules.name: n_alphas
rules.reason: Removed from scikit-learn in 1.9 (alphas takes an int now); Mojolearn still takes the count as n_alphas and alphas as a list.

rules.name: nochange_steps
rules.reason: cuML's SMO stopping control.

rules.name: algorithm
rules.reason: Removed from scikit-learn in 1.8 (SAMME only); Mojolearn still accepts 'SAMME'.

rules.name: c
rules.reason: cuML's neighbor-count factor for the 'knn' connectivity graph.

name: max_mbytes_per_batch
max_iterations
rules.reason: cuML's memory batch and label-propagation iteration controls of the GPU DBSCAN.

rules.name: max_depth
rules.reason: Tree depth cap (cuML-style); scikit-learn derives it from max_samples.

name: init_centroids
metric
oversampling_factor
rules.reason: init='array' takes its centers from init_centroids (cuML); metric and k-means|| oversampling are cuML's controls.

rules.name: penalty
rules.reason: cuML's penalty choice ('l1' or 'l2') of the GPU solver.

name: max_iter
tol
rules.reason: Iteration controls of the GPU solver; scikit-learn's HiGHS linear program takes none.

rules.name: normalize
rules.reason: Removed from scikit-learn in 1.2; Mojolearn keeps it (cuML still has it).

rules.name: verbose
rules.reason: Accepted for cuML compatibility; ignored.

rules.name: post_exaggeration_learning_rate_factor
rules.reason: cuML's schedule: the learning rate is multiplied by this factor after early exaggeration.

name: predict_with_leaves
staged_predict
rules.reason: Mojolearn forest methods: leaf indices with the prediction, and predictions after each tree.

rules.name: predict
rules.reason: cuML-style predict for new points; scikit-learn has fit_predict only.

rules.name: predict_joint_log_proba
rules.reason: Joint log-likelihood log P(x, y) per class, as scikit-learn's private _joint_log_likelihood made public.

name: staged_predict
staged_predict_proba
staged_decision_function
staged_score
rules.reason: Per-stage outputs are not produced by the native ensemble predict (kernel work).

rules.name: predict_log_proba
rules.reason: Not exposed: it needs a native log of the probability output (a PACK addition), not a Python log on the result.

name: decision_path
cost_complexity_pruning_path
rules.reason: Node-path and pruning-path outputs are not produced by the native trees (kernel work).

rules.name: path
rules.reason: The regularization path is not exposed as a method; the CV classes fit it natively and keep the chosen model.

name: kneighbors_graph
radius_neighbors
radius_neighbors_graph
kneighbors
rules.reason: Sparse neighbor graphs and radius queries on this class are not implemented natively (kernel and sparse PACK work); kneighbors on NearestNeighbors and RadiusNeighbors cover the queries.

rules.name: inverse_transform
rules.reason: The native transformer has no inverse kernel yet (kernel work).

rules.name: decision_function
rules.reason: The meta-estimator does not expose its members' decision function natively (kernel work).

name: correct_covariance
reweight_covariance
error_norm
rules.reason: The robust covariance fit runs these steps inside the native fit; they are not exposed as separate methods.

name: get_covariance
get_precision
score
score_samples
sample
dbscan_clustering
fit_predict
rules.reason: Not implemented natively; it needs kernel or PACK work, not a rename.

name: estimator_
estimators_
estimators_samples_
estimators_features_
rules.reason: The ensemble is one native model on the device; there are no per-member Python estimator objects or sample index arrays.

name: tree_
nbrs_
kernel_pca_
one_hot_encoder_
label_binarizer_
base_estimator_
le_
f_
feature_name_combiner
rules.reason: A Python helper object inside scikit-learn's fitted model (tree structure, neighbor index, sub-estimator, interpolator); Mojolearn keeps that state natively and exposes no such object.
Not stored by the compiled fit; adding it is a value from the native PACK or kernel work, not a rename.
Mojolearn-only fitted attribute (cuML-compatible or a solver report), documented in the class docstring.
